status: preregistered before execution; candidate, not reviewed or accepted

system.family: LLM-managed agent memory (extract/update memories via tool calls) over a LangGraph vector store
system.product: langmem 0.0.30 @ 48e3c11f5bb527282c7d5339c6a87a0b35abccfc (MIT), installed from that commit; environment ../langmem-venv-freeze.txt
system.manager: create_memory_store_manager with LangMem defaults (Memory schema, default instructions, inserts on, deletes off, query_limit 5)
system.storage: LangGraph InMemoryStore with a 768-d vector index (LangMem quick-start store; not persistent; pure-Python vector math because numpy is not a dependency)
system.llm: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct Q4_K_M (same pinned file as #812), llama-cpp-python 0.3.16, temperature 0, via reference/llamacpp_hermes_tools_shim.py (Hermes <tool_call> -> OpenAI tool_calls)
system.embeddings: nomic-embed-text v1.5 f16 (same pinned file as #812) via OpenAIEmbeddings(check_embedding_ctx_length=False)
system.capability_tier: LLM at ingestion (local 3B), same tier as Graphiti; separate row from no-LLM systems
system.deviation: LangMem documents hosted models (e.g. anthropic/openai); a local 3B model is used here; temperature 0 declared for reproducibility

adapter.ingest: one manager.invoke({'messages':[{'role':'user','content': document.content}]}) per AMB document; namespace per AMB user_id
adapter.search: manager.search(query, limit=k); k = AMB per-case retrieval_limit (maxBeliefs, default 20)
adapter.identity_mapping: memories created or changed during a document's invoke are attributed to that document (LangMem keeps no provenance); one AMB Document per attributed document per memory, in LangMem's order, cut to k

runs.repeat: rep 2 if host time allows; repeatability evidence only

outcomes: AMB native correct/77, pass classes, precision/recall, per-category
paired per case vs agent-memory and the no-LLM cohort, and vs graphiti-local (same tier)
LLM calls, tokens and wall time from the shim log; latency; peak RSS
failure_rules: a provider or harness exception (incl. an LLM tool-call failure surfaced by LangMem) fails the run; reported, not scored
concurrency_note: shares the single local LLM server with the concurrently running Graphiti AMB run; per-call latency is therefore not a performance measurement
smoke: ../smoke/synthetic-smoke.json: 5/5 structural checks passed before this registration
